1.title: Shooting at In-and-Out Burger in Idaho Leaves at Least 3 Dead and 2 Injured, Official Says
1.summary: A spokesman for Twin Falls cautioned that the number of victims was “expected to be higher.” The police said the shooter was dead.

2.title: Washington state wildfires trigger evacuations
2.summary: State officials said wildfires across more than 250,000 acres have led to widespread evacuations and power outages.

3.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
3.summary: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.

4.title: La Guaira Is Unrecognizable After Venezuela’s Deadly Earthquakes
4.summary: More than a month after the earthquakes, the coastal region of La Guaira — once Venezuela’s main gateway — is completely unrecognizable.

5.title: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
5.summary: Security officials said a woman tried to enter the restaurant with explosives but was stopped by a security guard.

6.title: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
6.summary: The vessel with at least 250 people on board caught fire off Madura island.
